tema: Present Perfect vs Past Simple — Connected or Finished?

cast_dialogue.linea: Two tenses, one question, heroes: is the time finished, or does it touch today? That is the key.
I lived in London for five years — that chapter is closed. But I've worked as a photographer since then.
I visited three countries last year. And this year I've already visited two more!
I've lived in Medellín all my life. I moved here when I was a child and I've loved it ever since.
I met your grandfather in 1975, and we were happy for fifty years. Finished time, past simple; living time, present perfect.

banco_oraciones.oracion: I have lived here all my life.
He has worked as a photographer since 2020.
I haven't seen him this week.
Have you ever been to London?
How long have you lived in this city?
Have you seen him today? Yes, I have.
Did you go out last night? No, I didn't.
Has she called this morning? No, she hasn't.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: Finished time (yesterday, last year, in 2020, when I was a child) → Past Simple. Unfinished or connected time (today, this week, since, for, ever, yet, already, so far) → Present Perfect.

filas: I have never been to London.
I have seen him twice this week.

ejercicios.afirmacion: We use the Past Simple with 'yesterday' and 'last year'.
We can say 'I have seen him yesterday'.

ejercicios.instruccion: Change 'last year' to 'twice' and adjust the tense.
Turn it into a question with 'How long'.
ejercicios.respuesta: How long has he worked here?

ejercicios.pregunta: Tell me one thing you did last year and one thing you have done this week.
ejercicios.respuesta: Last year I visited my grandmother. This week I have started a new book.

guion: Ben: How long have you lived in Medellín, Sofía?
Sofía: I've lived here all my life. I moved here when I was a child.
Ben: Lucky you! I lived in London for five years.
Sofía: Really? When did you leave?
Ben: I moved to Spain in 2020. I've worked as a photographer since then.
Sofía: And have you ever been back to London?
Ben: Not yet. But last year I visited three other countries!

comprension.pregunta: How long has Sofía lived in Medellín?
When did Ben move to Spain?

reading.texto: Sofía has lived in Medellín all her life. She moved there when she was a child and she has loved the city ever since. Last year she visited London, and she has already decided to go back. Ben lived in London for five years, but he moved to Spain in 2020. He has worked as a photographer since then. He hasn't visited Medellín yet, but Sofía has invited him many times.

preguntas.afirmacion: Sofía moved to Medellín as an adult.
Ben has worked as a photographer since 2020.
